tei:div.tei:p: "$ (107)༄༅// dpal mkha' spyod dbang pos mdzad pa'i ro snyoms skor drug gi khrid yig

bzhugs so/// / (108)༄༅// 'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po dang dag snang du dngos su mjal zhing*/ bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs gcig tu 'dus pa 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam 'phrul rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tilli pas dngos su byin gyis rlobs pa'i/ rje nā ro pa chen po de nyid kyis dka' ba mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis spyad de/ bla ma bsten zhing mos gus tshad med pa dang ldan nas/ thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen pos/ rnam par rtog pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ lha 'dre dang*/ sdug bsngal dang*/ na tsha dang*/ 'chi ba lam du khyer ba ro snyoms kyi gdams pa drug las/ de nyams su len pa la/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas/ slob ma snod dang ldan pa'i rgyud dbang bzhi'i smin par byas nas/ gnas yid du 'ong bar/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ yig brgya/ maṇḍal/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'i tshul rgya cher bsam la/ chos drug po re re yang dbang po rab 'bring tha ma'i nyams su len (109)tshul ma nor bar mdor bsdus te bstan pa la/ thog mar rnam rtog lam du khyer ba ni/ rab kyis rnam par rtog pa gar song*/ gang nas byung*/ gang du gnas bltas pas/ dus gsum dbyer med par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas/ rang sems skye med chos skur rtogs na sangs rgyas bya ba yin/ 'bring gis yul dus phyogs mtshams su rnam rtog 'gro 'ong gnas gsum la blta ba'i man ngag gis mtha' bral du ngo shes nas ma bcos spos bral lhug par bzhag pas yon tan thams cad rang 'char la 'gro/ tha mas lta stangs bzhi la nyan thos kyi zhi ba'i lta stangs kyis zhi gnas kyi brlan btsal/ seng ge'i lta stangs kyis sems gsal dwangs su 'jug /khro bo'i lta stangs kyis rig pa la dar btags/ lha tshangs pa'i lta stangs kyis rnam rtog rang 'gag la 'gro ba rig pas dbang po bsgyur ba ste/ zhi lhag zung 'jug gi man ngag dam pa yin/

'di ni rnam (110)rtog lam du khyer ba/ ltas ngan g.yang du blangs pa'i man ngag ste/ 'jig rten pa'ang ltas ngan mthong na rnam rtog gi 'phrig mi za bar grogs su 'gro ba dang 'dra dgos/ gnyis pa nyon mongs pa lam du khyer sa la/ rab kyis nyon mongs pa skye ba'i rgyu tshogs drug gi yul la bden zhen bskyed pas mdzes mi mdzes la sogs bde sdug sna tshogs 'byung bar mthong nas/ yul bden med sgyu ma ltar gtan la phab pas yul can rang 'gags pa rang bzhin gyis nye bar zhi ba skye ba med pa'i chos skur go zhing rtogs par 'gyur/ 'bring gis chags yul/ sdang yul/ rmongs yul rnams so sor shugs bskyed nas dmigs yul du byed pa'am/ yang na yul gcig gis gcig la dmigs pa spos nas yul du byas pas/ yul la zhen pa dang bral bas/ yul can dug gsum rang sar grol nas stong nyid rtogs par 'gyur/ tha mas chags yul la rnam par bam pa la sogs pa mi gtsang ba'i 'du shes bsgom/ sdang yul la byams pa bsgom/ rmongs yul la rten 'brel bsgoms pas dug gsum rang 'gags la rtsol med du 'gro/ nyon mongs lam du khyer/ dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i gdams ngag /sngags kyis bor ba'i nus pa bsad nas dug med par sman du 'gro ba dang 'dra dgos/ gsum pa lha 'dre lam du khyer ba ni/ brgya byin lta bu'i gdon dag ni/ mdun du nges par byung 'gyur na/ 'jigs pa tsam du mi bya ste/ seng ge'i tshul du rgya bar bya/ zhes pas/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bzhir bshad pas/ rab kyis bde sdug ro mnyam pas (111)bdud kyis mi tshugs pa'i spyod pa dran med yid la byar med spros bral chos sku mngon du byed/ 'bring gis lha 'dre rnam rtog gi rang bzhin bden pas stong par yang dang yang du dmigs pas spros bral du go

tha mas lha 'dre la mgron po'i tshul du lus gzan skyur gyi mchod sbyin byas lha 'dre dbang du 'dus nas dngos grub 'byung ba'i gdams pa'o// 'di ni lha 'dre lam du khyer ba bar chad dngos grub tu bsdu pa'i man ngag ste/ gcan gzan sgo drung du bkol bas rang la mi gnod par gzhan 'gogs pa dang 'dra dgos/ bzhi pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal lam du khyer ba ni/ gzhi ma rig pa/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa/ sgo gsum gyis bya bas 'bras bu sdug bsngal tshe 'di dang*/ tshe phyi ma dang*/ lan grangs tshe rabs gzhan du rkyen dang 'phrad nas las smin nas sdug bsngal ba'i sems can rnams la/ rab kyis bdag gzhan brje ba byang chub kyi sems bskyed/ 'bring gis bdag gzhan mnyam pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed/ tha mas bdag gzhan mnyam por mos pa byang chub kyi sems snying khong rus pa'i gting nas bskyed pa'i gdams pa 'di ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal lam du khyer ba byang chub sems kyi gdams ngag ste/ ma bu gcig par brtse bas ma bu gcig gis gcig mi 'dor ba dang 'dra dgos/ lnga pa na tsha lam du khyer ba/ gdon gyi nad/ 'byung ba bzhi 'khrugs pa'i nad/ rlung mkhris bad kan cham snyoms pa'i nad ngos bzung la/ rab kyis snying po med pa chu shing lta bu'i lus la bden 'dzin byas pa'i rnam rtog glo bur ba'i nad smig rgyu lta bu la spong sgrub med par gzhi med rtsa bral du bzhag /spros dang bral ba'i sems nyid skye ba med par rtogs pa lta bas grol bya ba yin/ (112)'bring gis nad ngos gzung la/ spang bya dang*/ gnyen po lta bu'i dmigs pa dang*/ nad thog tu nad dbab/ gdon thog tu gdon dbab pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ nad gnas su gang 'os kyi dmigs pa tshur khugs sam/ yang na bla ma'i sgu bsgom zhing mos gus drag tu byas pas nad sel ba ni/ dmigs pas nad 'don pa'o/ tha mas nad ngos bzung nas man ngag dang ldan pas/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor/

ngag rlung sbyor/ sems kyis bla ma la mos gus byas te brtson 'grus drag tu bya ba ni/ 'khrul 'khor gyis nad 'don pa yin/ 'di na na tsha lam du khyer ba 'byung ba re snyoms kyi man ngag ste/ byis pas gser dang bong ba la blang dor gyi zhen pa med pa dang 'dra dgos/ drug pa 'chi ba lam du khyer ba ni/ rab kyis gzhi'i 'od gsal ma lta bu dang*/ lam gyi 'od gsal bu lta bur gnas pa la/ 'chi tsa na/ rtogs pa'i 'od gsal dang*/ 'chi ka rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal gnyis nam mkha' dang nam mkha' ltar 'dres nas rnam rtog gnas 'gyur te/ rang don du chos sku/ gzhan don du gzugs skur sangs rgyas nas 'gro don rgya chen po 'byung la/ 'bring gis sgyu lus la goms shing chos thams cad sgyu ma'i dper rang bzhin med pa nyid du bsgoms pas rnam par dag cing grol bar 'gyur la/ tha mas mngal sgo dgag pa ni/ dad gus dang bslab pa gsum la gnas shing stong nyid bsgoms te bkag nas/ rigs khyad par can btsal ba'i skye ba phyi ma la mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i gdams pa ni/ 'chi ba lam du khyer ba ma bu ngo sprod pa'i gdams pa ste/ mtsho la kha ba thim pas dbyer med du 'gro ba dang 'dra dgos/ de yang*/ ji ltar rlung nad ldang pa la/ sran ma'i bza' ba sbyin par bya/ (113)rlung gis rlung ni 'joms par bya// ji ltar me yis 'tshigs pa la// me de nyid la gdung bar bya// ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa// chu de nyid kyis dbyung bar bya// 'dod chags nyid kyis gdung ba la// 'dod chags nyid kyis dbyung bar bya// bzlog pas sman du shes par bya/ bzlog pa'i bsgom pa 'di nyid ni// sangs rgyas mu stegs kyis mi shes// dpal ldan nā ro pa'i gdams pa ro snyoms skor drug gi don mdor bsdus te brjod kyis rgyas par spro zhing nyams su len pa la brtson par byos shig// / ༈ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/
tilli pa/ nā ro pa/ ti phu pa/ ras chung pa/ rgya ras/ rgod tshang pa/ o rgyan pa/ rang byung ba/ mgon rgyal ba/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ mkha' spyod pa'o/ (114)
